I am **Nikitas Rafael Nikitas**, a Senior Data Scientist based in Greece. My experience spans banking, fintech and travel technology, with more than eight years working on data science problems.

## Professional focus

At **eTraveli Group**, my work has included predictive modelling, dynamic pricing, cache optimisation, experimentation and fraud detection. I have experience deploying LightGBM models through FastAPI, building Airflow pipelines and mentoring junior data scientists.

I am interested in the complete path from defining a decision and evaluating a model to making the resulting system usable. This portfolio focuses on work I can share publicly. Public and synthetic demonstrations are labelled separately from professional experience.

## Areas of practice

| Area | What I work with |
|---|---|
| Predictive modelling | Python, SQL, LightGBM, CatBoost, XGBoost, feature engineering, SHAP |
| Statistical reasoning | Experiment design, uncertainty, model evaluation and decision metrics |
| ML systems | FastAPI, Airflow, reproducible pipelines and data validation |
| AI applications | Evidence retrieval, grounded explanations, evaluation and fallback behaviour |

## Selected public work

- [Beyond FIFA Potential](studies/fifa-hidden-gems/): historical scouting rankings and individual explanations.
- [Agora Match](studies/agora-match/): a synthetic football intelligence application with an inspectable evidence layer.
- [Football Forecasting Lab](studies/football-forecasting/): probabilistic score models, chronological backtesting and league simulation.
